name: Roseau Cathedral
scope: Our Lady of Fair Haven Cathedral in Roseau, Dominica, as photographed in December 2008. Includes the stone nave, attached side ranges, central tower and pre-replacement spire. The adjoining buildings, retaining walls outside the cathedral outline and interiors are outside this model.

stories.title: Roseau Cathedral: A Century of Volcanic Stone, Prisoner-Carved Pulpits, and Kalinago Craftsmanship

originalReview.notes: December 2008 view records the projecting stone tower, triple arched upper openings, pale statues, pointed west entry and the pre-replacement spire.

review.method: Exact published Qualla originals with native Commons SHA-1, pinned revisions and explicit public-domain dedication
review.notes: One exact published Qualla original by Nelro was accepted. The original upload log documents sole authorship and an explicit public-domain dedication. The source gives December 2008 without a day, so the first of the month is a representative viewing date. The October 2024 image was set aside because the spire had changed.
